title: Habit
summary: The father of American psychology on habit: the nervous system is plastic, so we become walking bundles of habits. Habits make actions automatic and free the mind. Start new habits with a strong decision, never allow an exception until the habit is rooted, act on every resolution right away, and train your will by doing a small hard thing every day.
